description: React component for configuring Single Sign-On (SSO) providers including Azure, Google, Auth0, and Github. It manages state, validation, API interactions, and UI rendering for SSO settings.

methods.name: validateAzureFields
methods.description: Validates Azure-specific input fields, pushing error messages if fields are blank.

methods.name: validateGoogleFields
methods.description: Validates Google-specific input fields, pushing error messages if fields are blank.

methods.name: validateGithubFields
methods.description: Validates Github-specific input fields, pushing error messages if fields are blank.

methods.name: validateAuth0Fields
methods.description: Validates Auth0-specific input fields, pushing error messages if fields are blank.

methods.name: validateFields
methods.description: Aggregates validation for all enabled providers and resets error state.

methods.name: constructRequestBody
methods.description: Builds the API request payload with current configuration states.

methods.name: validateAndSubmit
methods.description: Validates inputs, then submits the SSO configuration update via API, showing success or error notifications.

methods.name: validateAndTest
methods.description: Validates inputs for a specific provider, tests the login method, and shows success/error notifications.

methods.name: getSelectedProviderName
methods.description: Returns the name of the currently selected provider based on tab index.
